title: Agentic AI Meets Formal Verification in the Era of Agentic Hardware Development
abstract: arXiv:2611.13705v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As AI agents become increasingly capable of generating and optimizing hardware circuits, ensuring the correctness of AI-generated designs becomes more important. Meanwhile, advances in AI lower the barriers to developing and applying formal methods, creating new opportunities to automate and improve hardware verification. This invited paper presents an overview of the methodologies and applications of hardware formal methods in the AI era. First, we examine how agentic AI advances hardware formal methods across three levels: specification, proof construction, and reasoning engines. Second, we discuss how formal methods support reliable AI-driven hardware development through RTL generation, debugging, and correctness-preserving optimization. We review representative research alongside our recent contributions, highlighting key technical advances and insights from experimental results. translated_title: 智能体硬件开发时代：智能体AI与形式化验证的交汇
translated_abstract: 随着AI智能体在生成和优化硬件电路方面的能力日益增强，确保AI生成设计的正确性变得愈发重要。与此同时，AI的进步降低了开发和应用形式化方法的门槛，为自动化和改进硬件验证创造了新的机遇。这篇特邀论文概述了AI时代硬件形式化方法的方法论与应用。首先，我们探讨了智能体AI如何在三个层面推进硬件形式化方法：规约、证明构建和推理引擎。其次，我们讨论了形式化方法如何通过RTL生成、调试和保持正确性的优化来支持可靠的AI驱动硬件开发。我们回顾了代表性研究以及我们近期的贡献，重点介绍了关键技术进展和实验结果带来的洞见。最后，我们讨论了未来的研究机遇……
tldr: 本特邀论文综述了智能体AI与硬件形式化验证的双向协同关系：AI从规约、证明构建和推理引擎三个层面推进形式化方法的发展，而形式化方法则通过RTL生成、调试和保正确性优化保障AI驱动硬件开发的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This invited paper surveys the two-way synergy between agentic AI and hardware formal verification, where AI advances formal methods across specification, proof construction, and reasoning engines, while formal methods in turn enable reliable AI-driven hardware development through RTL generation, debugging, and correctness-preserving optimization.
